name: seraphic-legions-descent-level-three-pays-one-and-lets-you-activate-the-banished-angel
notes: Level 3+ ability: (1) plus the phantasia's auto-rest; target a card banished by the Legion and tag it _seraphicLegion, which makes it activatable from the banishment this turn (the banish click handler and highlight in GameLogic.php, same shape as Ashen Riffle / Devised Conspiracy). The tagged Angelic Vanguard is then activated from the banishment.

rulesClauses: [Level 3+] (1), [REST]: Until end of turn, you may activate target card banished by CARDNAME.

engineBug.summary: Seraphic Legion's Descent's level 3 ability was not implemented.
